message: In the evening, Ririmu and Setsugekka finally finished their remedial classes.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ughhh... My brain is dead...」
I sent Ririmu home first and called Keisetsu over.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Good work. Setsugekka, how was the remedial class?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I think I used up a whole year’s worth of brainpower...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You’d better work just as hard tomorrow.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Waaaaah, she’s a demon! There’s a demon right here!」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, now that we’re all here, let’s get started.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「D-don’t tell me... another round of remedial classes starts now...！？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, do you think I’m the one who needs a remedial class？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahaha, no way, no way at all.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You have something you want to discuss regarding Setsugekka, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that’s exactly it.」
As expected of Keisetsu, she’s quick on the uptake.

name: Iori
message: 「Right, I asked you to stay to talk about Setsugekka’s rampage. I’d like to hear the details in more depth.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, and we were just thinking that we needed Muragaki-san to understand the situation in more detail as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. I appreciate you being so straightforward.」
Keisetsu straightened her posture and turned to face me.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I believe you’ve already seen Setsugekka’s rampage... but that is a side effect of a certain technique.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The technique in question was discovered by a research laboratory under the Kazamine Group—the secret art of <d0057>Tamukai</d>.」

name: Iori
message: 「...Tamukai？ I’ve never heard of it.」
Working for the Tenju Special Forces gives me the chance to encounter all kinds of techniques. But I had never heard of the technique called “Tamukai”.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Naturally. Tamukai is a closely guarded secret art discovered by the Kazamine family. Including you, there are fewer than ten people who know of its existence.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I am about to tell you about this secret art, but if this information leaks to the outside... you’d best be prepared for the consequences.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Listen closely and steel yourself.」

name: Iori
message: 「O-okay.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Muragaki-san, are you familiar with what a <d0058>Saniwa</d> is？」

name: Iori
message: 「Aye. They’re beings capable of harboring gods or Keyou within their own bodies—essentially what you might call ‘living vessels.’」
A Saniwa is a type of spiritual medium.
Humans who possess the innate quality to resonate with and act as a conduit for gods or Keyou. In ancient times, they were known as shrine maidens or shamans.
It seems that by harboring a god or Keyou within themselves, a Saniwa can wield supernatural powers—spiritual energy or demonic energy.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Normally, one can only be a Saniwa if they are born with the aptitude.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But if you use the secret art of ‘Tamukai,’ you can turn the practitioner into a Saniwa later in life.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-what did you say...！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How about that, Teacher? Did you hear? Isn’t it amazing! Actually, I’m an artificially modified human!」
I find myself comparing Setsugekka and Keisetsu, my eyes going wide with shock.
So that’s it. Is Setsugekka... an artificial Saniwa...？

name: Iori
message: 「I never imagined you could artificially create a Saniwa through ritual techniques. I simply cannot believe it.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Of course, we had to overcome many difficult challenges before we could succeed. But the Kazamine family achieved it.」
Admittedly, if she is a Saniwa, then many things make sense. Since she harbors power that transcends human understanding, it’s only natural she’d go berserk.

name: Iori
message: 「But being a Saniwa is incredibly unstable, and they can become quite dangerous at times.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ve heard that the Keyou they harbor can affect their minds and bodies, or even cause their physical form to change.」
If two souls inhabit one vessel, they will naturally interfere with one another.
Because of this, their souls are eroded to a greater or lesser extent. It makes no difference whether the inhabitant is a god or a Keyou.

name: Iori
message: 「In fact, there have been cases where they became mental wrecks... or became targets for 'Satsuki' to eliminate. It’s an incredibly problematic practice.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, which is why all the test subjects were volunteers. I swear we never forced anyone.」
Once their body is taken over, they cannot resolve it themselves. In most cases, they are simply annihilated on the spot.

name: Iori
message: 「...So, that’s the secret art you performed on Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You know, Muragaki-sensei, I don't want you to misunderstand; I’m the one who asked for the secret art to be performed on me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You saw my mental resonance value earlier, right, Sensei? It was a pretty low number, wasn’t it?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「With those numbers, there's no way you'd have a chance in Jindou. You practiced Jindou too, Iori, so you know what I mean, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「……Yeah, you're right.」
I hate to say it, but with that level of spirit sensitivity, she wouldn't stand a chance against the top-tier students.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s why I asked Kei-chan for help. I told her I wanted to raise my spirit sensitivity.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And then Kei-chan found a way. That’s what the secret art ‘Tamukai’ is.」
……I see, so that’s how it was.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That’s as far as I can tell you, Muragaki. I’m afraid I can’t reveal anything more than this.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Knowing more would only put you in danger. You understand why, don’t you？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course. If they found out such a technique existed, the consequences would be far worse than just shedding blood.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Heh, exactly.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Does that mean you're talking about the <d0106>Spirit Agency</d> that Kei-chan is always mentioning？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, I’ve told you time and again not to bring that name up so carelessly.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Do you want to end up as a test subject for their human experiments？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh… I-I don’t know anything, and I won’t say anything! See no evil, hear no evil, speak no eviiil!」
Setsugekka hurriedly clamps her hand over her mouth.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「When it comes to this secret art, Setsugekka’s choice is my own. Everything we’ve decided is to beat the Suzakuin.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I explained the risks to Setsugekka many times, and if there were any other way, I would’ve taken it.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But after coming to this academy and seeing Suzakuin Momiji, I knew. We made the right choice.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「To defeat her, we absolutely need the power of this secret art.」
Keisetsu’s point is sound. In her natural state, Setsugekka wouldn’t have even a one-in-ten-thousand chance of winning.

name: Iori
message: 「Then we can’t get anywhere unless we do something about that runaway state.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Right. That’s where we need your cooperation. Please, I need you to lend us your strength.」
Of course, I have no intention of sparing any effort if it’s for Setsugekka’s sake.

name: Iori
message: 「Do you have any idea what it is that’s possessed Setsugekka？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「According to the exorcist I had check her immediately after the procedure, they said it might be some kind of ‘Mizuchi’.」

name: Iori
message: 「Mizuchi… so, a descendant of a serpent god or dragon god, then.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Right. As you know, snakes and dragon gods are masters of water. They have a positive side that brings blessings to people, and a fierce, negative side.」
Think of it as gentle rivers or spring water. Life-giving water that has supported human existence since time immemorial.
The fierce, negative side is like raging, stormy seas or a thundering great river. The power of water that swallows and crushes everything in its path.

name: Iori
message: 「Snakes shed their skin, casting off the old to be reborn as new. They also have an aspect of constant ‘death and rebirth,’ don’t they.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooh, that sounds cool~！ The immortal swordsman Snake Setsugekka, reporting for duty！」

name: Iori
message: 「This isn't the time to be joking around. Because of that mizuchi, after you lose control, you end up doing things like that...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kyaaaaaaaa！？ W-w-what are you talking about！？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...‘Things like that’？」
Well, at least now I understand why Setsugekka gets so horny.
Snakes are the embodiment of reproduction, and they govern sexual desire as well. I suppose the mizuchi's runaway power just amplifies her libido.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「............ Oh, never mind. Let's get back to the subject.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The god dwelling within Setsugekka is likely a nameless snake god or dragon god. That in itself isn't particularly rare.」

name: Iori
message: 「True, being possessed by snakes is a common story. It’s right up there with <d0081>fox</d> or dog possessions.」
Still, given the way it spirals out of control, there’s no doubt that the god is quite powerful.

name: Iori
message: 「Now that we generally know the god's identity, the question is how to actually control these outbursts.」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, what does it feel like when you lose control？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm... It’s like, I get this unbearable feeling of irritation, and I just want to lash out at everything.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s like someone is standing really close to me, acting all angry, and their agitation just makes me angry too.」

name: Iori
message: 「So your emotions are being influenced by the god inside you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, I guess that’s about right~」

name: Iori
message: 「Can you still control your own body？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don’t really feel like my body is being puppeted.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But, once I enter my ‘Midare Setsugekka’ mode, I get all heated up, and even I don't really know what I’m doing anymore.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wonder what that’s all about~」
I see, so that’s what she meant before by saying her 『memories get fuzzy.’

name: Iori
message: 「And after you lose control？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A-after I lose control... well, I just get a fever and my body feels incredibly sluggish, that's all.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s all？」

name: Setsugekka
message: （Sensei, don't press me any further on that！！）
She pleaded with me through eye contact.

name: Iori
message: 「A-anyway, if you lose control, you can’t win matches you otherwise would. We need to make sure you don't lose control if we can help it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Exactly, exactly! Losing control is absolutely forbidden! I’d like to ban it if I could, it’s just completely no-go!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But as it stands, you inevitably lose control whenever you draw out the power of the god within.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「And if you don't draw out that power, you cannot defeat Suzakuin Momiji.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that’s right. Which is why you need training to draw out the power without losing control.」

name: Iori
message: 「Based on what I’ve just heard, we should start by learning to control your anger.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Anger management, then.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Anger-manage...？ What’s that？」

name: Iori
message: 「Basically, it means trying not to get angry even when you’re upset.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I feel like when you’re upset, you’re already angry. Is it even possible to hold that back？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Putting the matter of the berserk state aside, that bad habit of yours of getting hot-headed and acting recklessly is something that needs to be fixed immediately.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh... your words are like knives dealing critical damage...！」
Setsugekka clutched her chest in pain.

name: Iori
message: 「In any case, as long as you can’t control it, we need to ensure you don’t lose control.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even if you’ve been fine up until now, there’s a possibility that it could have an irreversible effect on your mind.」
If her mind were to be swallowed by the Keyou, there would be no turning back.

name: Iori
message: 「No, there’s even a possibility that it’s already having an effect. Setsugekka’s flighty personality might be the fault of the god within her.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「There’s no need to worry about that. Setsugekka has been like this since she was born.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see... That’s a shame.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What do you mean ‘a shame,’ are you making fun of my personality?!」
Setsugekka has recovered.

name: Iori
message: 「W-well, personality aside, there’s a chance that a berserk state could lead to a major catastrophe if you slip up even once.」

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone would be sad if something happened to you, Setsugekka, so I want you to be as careful as you can.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Th-Thank you so much. You really do worry about me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course I do. You're one of my precious students, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sniff, sniff... Muragaki-sensei really is such a good person...！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, I'm glad you got to meet such a good teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hearing you say that makes me happy, even if it's just flattery.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei, you know. I really love Jindou.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I watch pro matches a lot too, and during Jindou matches, everyone gives it their all and shines so brightly」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I've always thought I wanted to become like that someday too.」

name: Iori
message: 「So you want to become a pro Jindou athlete, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, I wonder about that. Still, I want to keep doing Jindou forever.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's why I want to properly master this inner god's power too, so I can fight on equal footing with Momimomi.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei... will you help me？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course！」
I clench my fist tightly in front of her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Thank you so much, Muragaki-sensei!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「All right, Kei-chan, I'm gonna give it my all！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, I have high hopes for you, Setsugekka.」
Hearing about the secret art, I realized Setsugekka has strong determination and resolve.
I don't intend to play favorites with just her, but I want to help her out as much as I can.
